name: puja-circle
description: Traditional rituals, made easier for modern India. Web platform connecting devotees with verified priests.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend

author: PujaCircle Engineering Team
